markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
The conformal set holds Normal only, and the second model and all neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 98%, InSitu 1%, Benign 1% | One class dominates |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | No input flag raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Normal | Full agreement |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Strongest lower-invasive association, but its spot check failed [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Prominent benign stroma, linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Prominent tubules, linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Only signal toward invasive; modest, one region · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- A small invasive focus near region 11 is under-represented among the benign regions.
- The reliability score ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69, CI 0.58–0.87) on simulated frozen sections.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 11**: look for true stromal infiltration; the infiltrating-stroma score peaks here.
2. **Regions 3, 10**: confirm benign lobules; the normal-lobule concept failed its spot check.
3. **Region 6**: check for atypical cells confined to ducts (InSitu 1%).
